body.text: Is the battery switch ON and is the 15 A start fuse F2 good? TEST OPTIONS: Look at the switch. Pull F2 and check it with the multimeter. REASON FOR QUESTION: A switch left OFF or a blown fuse stops all cranking current. KNOWN INFO: The engine does not crank. POSSIBLE PROBLEMS: Battery switch off. Start fuse F2 blown. Battery discharged. Starter relay K1 failed. If NO: Turn the battery switch ON or replace fuse F2, then try to start. Does the engine crank now? If it cranks but the temperature lamp comes on: go to Table 3-2, question 1.

section.heading: Engine will not crank
section.text: Table 3-1. Engine will not crank. Diesel variant only.

hits.text: Table 3-1, Question 2. What is the battery voltage at terminals B+ and B- with the key OFF? TEST OPTIONS: Measure at the battery terminals with the multimeter on DC volts. REASON FOR QUESTION: Cranking needs a charged battery; below 11.5 V the starter cannot turn the engine. KNOWN INFO: Battery switch ON. Fuse F2 good. POSSIBLE PROBLEMS: Battery discharged. Starter relay K1 failed. Starter motor failed. Below 11.5 V: Replace the battery. Refer to task 4-3. From 11.5 V to 12.5 V: Charge the battery, then repeat the voltage test. 12.5 V or more: go to question 3.
Battery replacement: remove the hold-down clamp and lift out the battery.

hits.heading: Battery replacement
hits.text: Battery replacement. Task 4-3. Battery replacement. Diesel variant only.

hits.heading: Starting circuit
hits.text: Starting circuit. Figure 3-1. Starting circuit wiring: battery, battery switch, fuse F2, key switch, starter relay K1, starter motor.
Task 4-3, Step 1. Turn the battery switch OFF.

Table 3-1, Question 3. Is more than 10 V present at starter relay K1 terminal 86 when the key is turned to START? REASON FOR QUESTION: Voltage at terminal 86 shows the key switch and wiring deliver the start signal. KNOWN INFO: Battery OK. Fuse OK. POSSIBLE PROBLEMS: Starter relay K1 failed. Starter motor failed. Key switch or wiring open. If NO: Key switch or wiring fault. Refer to field maintenance for wiring repair.
